assessment: Utah County GIS publishes the parcel map and nightly Tax Parcels based on Recorder parcel linework and Assessor detail. The actual adapter completed a 13-cell read from the county TaxParcels_mobile 4K layer, verified 157 unique safe parcel IDs by fresh rereads, paging, absence, and WUP-point containment. Proposal binding and whole-sample topology fail: 350180500 overlaps target 350180070 by 9.44 m², and the 157-feature sample has 221 positive-area overlap pairs. Do not enable this candidate pending root review; no catalog/runtime descriptor is added.

remainingUncertainty: The county layer contains material overlap topology and creates multiple-parcel proposal binding for the target geometry. COGO layer4 count/OID manifests disagree, while Simple_wgs84 stopped on a transport error. Alternate scales match geometry at the point but were not fully qualified. Citywide completeness, legal/title authority, and whether another layer represents parcels more cleanly remain unresolved.
nextStep: Root independently audits the stored qualification and topology summaries. Keep source disabled; resolve overlapping geometries and multiple-ID binding before any runtime proposal use.

runtimeAssessment.reason: The Utah County public 4K assessment-map layer returns full point-containing parcel geometry and passes thirteen-cell count/OID manifests, forced small pages and fresh reads of all 157 native parcel IDs. Its complete polygons overlap: independent root EPSG:26912 GEOS audit records 183 pairs above 0.01 m², 787.125 m² aggregate overlap and no invalidity, duplicates or operation errors. The target-footprint proposal binds three parcels instead of one, including a material 9.44 m² intrusion. COGO completeness and an alternate profile transport failure are preserved separately. These are source-model/topology incompatibilities with exclusive parcel ground, not evidence of unavailable cadastre or absent public geometry.
